about: Zenkai Z1 intent examples for the 2026-11-09 phrase-step ruling (Pratik: 'small' editing phrases move modestly more so the effect is visible). Intent: 'a touch more X' must land its measured stat change inside [floor, 1.5 x floor] of the gauntlet's perceptibility floor for that phrase's stat, never below it and never wildly above. Z2 two oracles: oracle A is arithmetic on the RECORDED night-3 evidence in this file (stat change measured per unit of param change, from observation.stats_before/after and the applied move, scaled to the new touch delta); oracle B is the product's own resolver (scouter.core.phrases.resolve + vocab step) giving the touch delta the vocabulary now plans. The 'residual' examples are phrases whose step cannot clear its floor inside the vocab safety invariant step <= (hi-lo)/4; they assert the shortfall so a later fix is noticed (no skip, no xfail).
subject: scouter/core/vocab.py sigmoid.contrast and exposure.black step; scouter/core/phrases.py INTENSITY (touch = 0.5 notch)
